body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):

  - [x] AWS Bedrock
  - [x] Google Vertex AI
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.72 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: macOS 15.3.2 (24D81)
- Terminal:  Warp

## Bug Description
Unable to delete an MCP server. Probably a problem with servers with dashes in their name.

## Steps to Reproduce
Add a server with dashes, such as `always-sunny`

## Expected Behavior
The MCP server would be removed.

## Actual Behavior
I get the error:
> No local MCP server found with name: always-sunny
